title: Pagination boundary calculation
description: A small correctness scenario where the final item is omitted from each page.
code:
def page_items(items: list[str], page: int, page_size: int) -> list[str]:
    start = page * page_size
    end = start + page_size - 1
    return items[start:end]

expected_issues.title: Page slice omits its final item
expected_issues.description: Python slice end indices are exclusive, so subtracting one causes each page to omit its last intended item.
